title: Letter qualities: whispered and voiced letters (hams and jahr): rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Inshiqaq and the sifat of strength
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 3 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Letter qualities rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 3. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: What are sifat?
points: Makhraj: where a letter is made
Two letters, same place, different sifat: ت and د

head: Hams (همس): whispered
Jahr (جهر): voiced
rows: ف ح ث ه ش خ ص س ك ت

head: Not this
This
rows: inshaqqad: the final ت closed with no breath
inshaqqat: a light breath after the ت

keywords.def: the qualities of a letter's sound (singular sifah)
whispered: the breath flows with the letter
voiced: the breath is held back

questions.q: Say «وَحُقَّتْ» (84:2) and show the breath on the ت.
questions.a: wa huq-qat: a light breath after the final ت (hams).

questions.q: Tissue test (pupil PDF): say 10 letters with sukoon (اَتْ اَدْ اَسْ ...) and write H or J for each. Today's rota group recites 84:1 to 5 in turn.
questions.a: Hams: ت س ك ف ه ش ح; jahr: د ب ج (from the list on the sheet).

questions.q: Extend: write the hams phrase from memory.
Stretch: ت and د are made in the same place. What makes them different?
questions.a: ت is hams (breath flows); د is jahr (breath held).
A) س. س is in فَحَثَّهُ شَخْصٌ سَكَتَ. د and ب are jahr.

questions.q: Think again: Hold a tissue in front of your mouth and say 'at' then 'ad'. Which one moves the tissue?
questions.a: 'At' (ت) lets a little breath out: hams. 'Ad' (د) holds the breath: jahr.
